task: MM-FIX-1 — Make Maven reactor JUnit inventory discovery version-coherent per module
mainStpAfter: SELF (the focused commit containing this verification artifact)
rootCause: The prior boundary selected target ownership from launcher presence alone and loaded all org.junit.jupiter/org.junit.platform classes child-first. SonarJava's compilation-only default module therefore combined Jupiter API 5.14.0 with engine/platform 6.1.3 and failed on MethodOrderer$Default. Modules that did not supply a launcher instead used an implicit hybrid of STP and target JUnit classes/providers.
ownershipModel: Per module: a complete target stack owns Jupiter API/engine and Platform launcher/engine/commons; otherwise STP owns the complete stack and target JUnit classes plus TestEngine service providers are excluded.
classloaderStrategy: Fresh loader per module. Target-complete mode is child-first only for org.junit.platform.*, org.junit.jupiter.*, and the worker. STP-owned mode is parent-only for org.junit.* and parent-only for the TestEngine provider resource. Other target classes retain normal parent-first URLClassLoader behavior.
